rough: ὁδοί (Is, l.with), Luk.3:5 (LXX); τοποί (i.e. rocky), Act.27:29.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.
